admission.title: Eligibility & Admission Criteria (DSE)
content: **Admission Score Formula**: Any Best 5 Subjects.
**Median Admission Score**: N/A (2025 JUPAS data).
**Lower Quartile**: N/A (2025 JUPAS data).
**Subject Weighting**: Subject weighting in details.
**Core Subjects Minimum Level**: Chinese Language 3, English Language 3, Mathematics (Compulsory Part) 2, Citizenship and Social Development Attained.

curriculum.title: Curriculum Overview
content: **Programme Overview**: JS3636 BSc in Physiotherapy is a 4-year full-time honours programme under the Faculty of Health, designed to produce competent physiotherapists with strong clinical reasoning and evidence-based practice skills.
**Year 1**: Foundation sciences including Anatomy, Physiology, Biomechanics, and Psychology. Students also take introductory Physiotherapy Practice and Communication Skills.
**Year 2**: Core physiotherapy subjects such as Musculoskeletal Physiotherapy, Cardiorespiratory Physiotherapy, and Neurological Physiotherapy. Clinical placements begin with observational visits.

**Year 3**: Advanced clinical reasoning, Electrotherapy, Paediatric Physiotherapy, Geriatric Physiotherapy, and Research Methods. Students undertake supervised clinical placements in hospitals and community settings.
**Year 4**: Professional Practice, Healthcare Management, and a Capstone Research Project. Extended clinical placements (over 1,000 hours total) prepare students for registration.

**Work-Integrated Education (WIE)**: Mandatory clinical placements across public hospitals, private clinics, and rehabilitation centres, totalling at least 1,000 hours, ensuring hands-on experience under registered physiotherapists.

career.title: Career Prospects
content: **Professional Registration**: Graduates are eligible to apply for registration with the Physiotherapists Board of Hong Kong, enabling practice as a Registered Physiotherapist (Part Ia).
**Employment Sectors**: Over 90% of graduates secure employment within 6 months, working in Hospital Authority (HA) hospitals, private hospitals, clinics, sports teams, elderly homes, and NGOs.
**Diverse Roles**: Physiotherapists work in orthopaedics, neurology, paediatrics, geriatrics, sports medicine, cardiorespiratory care, and community rehabilitation.
**Further Studies**: Graduates can pursue Master’s or PhD in Physiotherapy, Sports Science, or Healthcare Management, with pathways to academic or research careers.
**Global Demand**: Physiotherapy is a regulated profession with high demand in Hong Kong, Mainland China, and overseas (e.g., UK, Australia, Canada), offering international mobility.
**Salary Range**: Starting monthly salary for fresh graduates in HA hospitals is approximately HK$35,000–$40,000, with private practice offering higher potential earnings.

campus.title: Campus Life & Facilities
content: **Prime Location**: PolyU is located in Hung Hom, Kowloon, directly connected to Hung Hom MTR station (East Rail Line and Tuen Ma Line), with easy access to all districts.
**State-of-the-Art Labs**: The programme uses dedicated Physiotherapy Skills Labs equipped with electrotherapy machines, exercise equipment, gait analysis systems, and virtual rehabilitation tools.
**Clinical Simulation Centre**: A purpose-built facility with mock hospital wards, outpatient clinics, and community settings for realistic training scenarios.
**Sports & Recreation**: The campus offers a multi-purpose sports hall, swimming pool, fitness centre, and over 50 student sports clubs, including the Physiotherapy Student Society.
**Library & Study Spaces**: The Pao Yue-kong Library provides 24/7 study areas, extensive health sciences databases, and a dedicated Physiotherapy collection.
**Student Support**: Comprehensive services including academic advising, career counselling, mental health support, and the PolyU Student Affairs Office (SAO) for personal development.

competitiveness.title: Competitiveness & Admission
content: **Overall Level**: High (★★★★☆)
**Admission Score Formula**: Any Best 5 Subjects — the programme considers the best 5 HKDSE results, allowing flexibility for students with varied strengths.
**Subject Weighting**: Core subjects (English, Chinese, Mathematics, Liberal Studies) are weighted equally, with Science subjects (Biology, Chemistry, Physics) given additional bonus for relevance.
**Median Score (2025)**: N/A — the programme has not released median scores for 2025 entry; however, historical data suggests competitive scores around 25–30 points (Best 5).
**Lower Quartile (2025)**: N/A — similar to median, lower quartile data is not yet available; applicants should aim for strong performance in Biology and English.
**Interview Requirement**: Shortlisted candidates are invited for a group interview and practical assessment, testing communication skills, empathy, and problem-solving abilities.
**Demand vs. Places**: Physiotherapy is one of the most competitive programmes at PolyU, with over 1,000 applicants for approximately 40–50 places each year (acceptance rate ~4–5%).

alumni.title: Notable Alumni & Achievements
content: **Dr. Chan Wai-keung (陳偉強博士)**: Renowned physiotherapist and researcher, former Head of Physiotherapy at the Hospital Authority, known for contributions to stroke rehabilitation.
**Ms. Lee Sze-wing (李思穎女士)**: Chief Physiotherapist at Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital, specialising in sports injuries and orthopaedic rehabilitation. PolyU graduate (1998).
**Mr. Wong Ka-ho (黃家豪先生)**: Founder of PhysioCare Hong Kong, a chain of private physiotherapy clinics with 10+ locations across Kowloon and New Territories. Graduated in 2005.
**Dr. Hui Ka-kin (許家健博士)**: Senior Lecturer at PolyU’s Department of Rehabilitation Sciences, leading research on paediatric physiotherapy and cerebral palsy interventions.
**Ms. Tam Mei-ling (譚美玲女士)**: Physiotherapist for the Hong Kong Sports Institute, working with elite athletes in athletics, fencing, and cycling. PolyU graduate (2012).
**Mr. Cheung Tsz-fung (張子峰先生)**: Clinical Specialist in Cardiorespiratory Physiotherapy at Queen Elizabeth Hospital, recognised for COVID-19 rehabilitation protocols.

scholarships.title: Scholarships & Financial Aid
content: **PolyU Entry Scholarship**: Awarded to top HKDSE achievers (e.g., 5** in multiple subjects) with amounts up to full tuition fee coverage (HK$42,100/year) plus living allowance.
**Faculty of Health Scholarships**: Merit-based scholarships for Health Sciences students, including the Dr. Li Shu Pui Scholarship (HK$20,000) for outstanding academic performance.
**Physiotherapy Programme Scholarship**: Specific to JS3636 students, awarded annually to 2–3 students with highest GPA and clinical placement performance (HK$10,000–$15,000).
**Government Financial Assistance**: Students can apply for the HKSAR Government’s Tertiary Student Finance Scheme (TSFS) and Non-means-tested Loan Scheme (NLS).
**External Scholarships**: Opportunities such as the Hong Kong Jockey Club Scholarships and HSBC Scholarships, open to PolyU students with strong community service records.
**Work-Study Scheme**: Part-time on-campus jobs (e.g., research assistants, library aides) available to help students manage living expenses while studying.

tips.title: Ace Sir's JS3636 Strategy — 9 Actionable Tips
content: **1. Prioritise Biology and English in HKDSE**

- Aim for Level 5 or above in Biology, as it is highly relevant to physiotherapy content (anatomy, physiology).
- English is critical for patient communication and academic reading — target Level 5 or above.
- Physics and Chemistry are also valued but Biology carries the most weight.
**2. Build a Strong Best 5 Score**

- Use the 'Any Best 5 Subjects' formula to your advantage: drop your weakest subject.
- Historical competitive scores are around 25–30 points; aim for at least 26 points to be safe.
- Include one elective with high scoring potential (e.g., Economics or Geography) if sciences are weaker.
**3. Prepare for the Group Interview**

- Practice discussing healthcare scenarios in English and Cantonese.
- Demonstrate empathy, teamwork, and problem-solving — these are key traits physiotherapists need.
- Research current physiotherapy issues in Hong Kong (e.g., ageing population, sports injuries).
**4. Gain Relevant Experience**

- Volunteer at hospitals, elderly homes, or sports events to show commitment to healthcare.
- Shadow a physiotherapist for at least 20 hours to understand the daily work.
- Mention this experience in your personal statement and interview.
**5. Write a Compelling Personal Statement**

- Explain why physiotherapy specifically (not just healthcare in general).
- Link your experiences to the programme’s focus on evidence-based practice and clinical placements.
- Keep it concise (500–800 words) and proofread for clarity.
**6. Excel in Science and Maths**

- Strengthen your understanding of biomechanics and human movement — these are core Year 1 topics.
- Practice basic statistics for research methods in Year 3.
- Use online resources like Khan Academy for anatomy revision.
**7. Network with Current Students**

- Attend PolyU Open Day and talk to Physiotherapy students about their experiences.
- Join online forums (e.g., DSE discussion groups) to ask about interview tips.
- Connect with the PolyU Physiotherapy Student Society on social media.
**8. Manage Your Time for Clinical Placements**

- Be prepared for intensive placement schedules (e.g., 8-hour shifts, 5 days a week).
- Develop time management skills early — use planners or apps to balance study and placement.
- Ensure you have a backup plan for transportation to hospitals across Hong Kong.
**9. Consider Alternative Pathways**

- If your HKDSE score is below the cutoff, consider associate degrees in Health Studies or Sports Science, then top-up to PolyU’s Physiotherapy programme.
- PolyU also offers a Master’s in Physiotherapy for graduates with a related bachelor’s degree.
- Stay flexible — the healthcare field values diverse backgrounds.

curriculum.title: 課程概覽
content: **課程概覽**：JS3636 物理治療學(榮譽)理學士為四年制全日制課程，隸屬健康學院，旨在培養具備臨床推理及實證實踐能力的專業物理治療師。
**第一年**：基礎科學包括解剖學、生理學、生物力學及心理學。學生亦修讀物理治療實務導論及溝通技巧。
**第二年**：核心物理治療科目如肌肉骨骼物理治療、心肺物理治療及神經科物理治療。臨床實習以觀察為主。
**第三年**：進階臨床推理、電療學、兒科物理治療、老年物理治療及研究方法。學生在醫院及社區進行督導實習。
**第四年**：專業實踐、醫療管理及畢業專題研究。總計超過1,000小時的臨床實習，為註冊做好準備。
**工作綜合教育（WIE）**：強制性臨床實習，涵蓋公立醫院、私家診所及康復中心，在註冊物理治療師指導下累積實戰經驗。

career.title: 就業前景
content: **專業註冊**：畢業生可申請香港物理治療師管理局註冊，成為註冊物理治療師（第Ia部分）。
**就業領域**：超過90%畢業生在6個月內就業，任職於醫院管理局（HA）醫院、私家醫院、診所、運動隊伍、安老院及非政府組織。
**多元角色**：物理治療師可專注於骨科、神經科、兒科、老年科、運動醫學、心肺復康及社區復康。
**進修途徑**：畢業生可攻讀物理治療、運動科學或醫療管理碩士或博士，邁向學術或研究事業。
**全球需求**：物理治療為受規管專業，在香港、內地及海外（如英國、澳洲、加拿大）需求甚殷，具國際流動性。
**薪酬範圍**：HA醫院畢業生起薪約每月HK$35,000–$40,000，私營市場收入潛力更高。

campus.title: 校園生活與設施
content: **優越位置**：理大位於九龍紅磡，毗鄰紅磡港鐵站（東鐵線及屯馬線），交通四通八達。
**先進實驗室**：課程設有專用物理治療技能實驗室，配備電療儀器、運動設備、步態分析系統及虛擬復康工具。
**臨床模擬中心**：設有模擬病房、門診診所及社區環境，提供真實訓練場景。
**運動與康樂**：校園設有綜合體育館、游泳池、健身中心及超過50個學生運動學會，包括物理治療學生會。
**圖書館與自修空間**：包玉剛圖書館提供24/7自修區、大量健康科學數據庫及物理治療專藏。
**學生支援**：全面的學術輔導、就業諮詢、心理健康支援及學生事務處（SAO）個人發展服務。

competitiveness.title: 競爭力與入學要求
content: **入學分數公式**：最佳5科 — 課程考慮DSE最佳5科成績，讓學生靈活發揮優勢。
**科目權重**：核心科目（英文、中文、數學、通識）權重相等，理科（生物、化學、物理）因相關性獲額外加分。
**2025年入學中位數**：暫無數據 — 課程未公布2025年中位數；歷史數據顯示競爭分數約25–30分（最佳5科）。
**2025年下四分位數**：暫無數據 — 申請人應在生物及英文科取得佳績。
**面試要求**：入圍者需參加小組面試及實務評估，測試溝通技巧、同理心及解難能力。
**需求與學額**：物理治療為理大競爭最激烈課程之一，每年約1,000人申請40–50個學額（錄取率約4–5%）。

alumni.title: 知名校友與成就
content: **陳偉強博士**：著名物理治療師及研究員，前醫院管理局物理治療部主管，以中風復康研究聞名。
**李思穎女士**：養和醫院首席物理治療師，專注運動創傷及骨科復康。1998年理大畢業。
**黃家豪先生**：PhysioCare Hong Kong創辦人，連鎖私家物理治療診所，於九龍及新界設有10多間分店。2005年畢業。
**許家健博士**：理大康復治療科學系高級講師，領導兒科物理治療及腦麻痺干預研究。
**譚美玲女士**：香港體育學院物理治療師，為田徑、劍擊及單車精英運動員提供服務。2012年理大畢業。
**張子峰先生**：伊利沙伯醫院心肺物理治療臨床專科醫生，因COVID-19復康方案獲認可。

scholarships.title: 獎學金與財務資助
content: **理大入學獎學金**：頒予DSE成績優異者（如多科5**），金額可達全額學費（每年HK$42,100）及生活津貼。
**健康學院獎學金**：健康科學學科績優獎學金，包括李樹培博士獎學金（HK$20,000），獎勵學術表現卓越者。
**物理治療課程獎學金**：專為JS3636學生而設，每年頒予2–3名GPA及臨床實習表現最優者（HK$10,000–$15,000）。
**政府資助**：學生可申請香港政府專上學生資助計劃（TSFS）及免入息審查貸款計劃（NLS）。
**校外獎學金**：如香港賽馬會獎學金及滙豐獎學金，開放予社區服務紀錄優良的理大學生。
**工作學習計劃**：校內兼職（如研究助理、圖書館助理）協助學生應付生活開支。

tips.title: Ace Sir JS3636 攻略 — 9 個實用貼士
content: **1. 優先提升DSE生物及英文科成績**

- 生物科目標達5級或以上，因與物理治療內容（解剖、生理）高度相關。
- 英文科對病人溝通及學術閱讀至關重要，目標5級或以上。
- 物理及化學亦受重視，但生物科權重最高。
**2. 建立強勁的最佳5科分數**

- 善用「最佳5科」公式，剔除最弱科目。
- 歷史競爭分數約25–30分，建議目標至少26分以策安全。
- 若理科較弱，可選一科易取高分選修科（如經濟或地理）。
**3. 準備小組面試**

- 練習以英語及粵語討論醫療情境。
- 展現同理心、團隊合作及解難能力——這些是物理治療師必備特質。
- 研究香港當前物理治療議題（如人口老化、運動創傷）。
**4. 獲取相關經驗**

- 在醫院、安老院或體育活動擔任義工，展示對醫療的承擔。
- 跟隨物理治療師見習至少20小時，了解日常工作。
- 在個人陳述及面試中提及這些經驗。
**5. 撰寫具說服力的個人陳述**

- 解釋為何選擇物理治療（而非一般醫療）。
- 將經驗與課程重點（實證實踐、臨床實習）聯繫。
- 保持簡潔（500–800字）並仔細校對。
**6. 精通科學及數學**

- 加強生物力學及人體動作的理解——這些是第一年核心課題。
- 為第三年研究方法練習基礎統計。
- 利用Khan Academy等網上資源複習解剖學。
**7. 與現屆學生建立聯繫**

- 參加理大開放日，與物理治療學生交流經驗。
- 加入網上論壇（如DSE討論群組）請教面試貼士。
- 在社交媒體關注理大物理治療學生會。
**8. 管理臨床實習時間**

- 為密集實習日程做好準備（如8小時輪班，每週5天）。
- 及早培養時間管理技巧——使用計劃簿或應用程式平衡學習與實習。
- 確保有後備交通方案前往香港各區醫院。
**9. 考慮其他升學途徑**

- 若DSE分數未達標，可考慮健康研究或運動科學副學士，再銜接理大物理治療課程。
- 理大亦提供物理治療碩士課程，供持有相關學士學位者報讀。
- 保持靈活——醫療領域重視多元背景。
